subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase the open fork PR for the Debug Snapshots fix, or close/supersede that path so a fresh narrow fix can proceed from this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the only open closing PR is conflicting, has an old head, and cannot be modified by maintainers, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or the contributor rebase and repair the fork branch against the current Debug page structure before review.

recommendation.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the original Debug dashboard wiring and is the clearest routing candidate for choosing the repair path.
